narration: Trial budgets get negotiated on numbers the other side can't reproduce. In WCG's twenty twenty-five survey, seventy-three percent of six hundred eleven sites named budgets and contracts as a top contributor to start-up delay.

narration: Of twenty products we reviewed, none says publicly that it prices budget lines at the site's Medicare locality. CMS's free tool does it one code at a time. They have negotiated-price benchmarks; we don't.

narration: Concord is decision support, not a fair-market-value legal opinion. Free, open source, every number sourced or labelled an assumption. Built by the Bruno Bears at Brown. Our ask: site-level enrollment data. The registry never reports it.
